figurative_meaning_en: Unreasonable or unrealistic claim; overstepping bounds; excess
similar_in_english: The sky is the limit (in a negative sense of excess)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার লোভের গাঁ নাই সীমানা, সবকিছু দাবি করে।
এই ব্যবসায়ীর লাভের গাঁ নাই সীমানা।
example_sentences_in_english: His greed has no village boundaries; he demands everything.
That businessman's profit knows no bounds.
note: The idiom draws from rural Bengali imagery of vast, unbounded villages to metaphorically express limitlessness in negative traits like greed.
